name: Smith Machine Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand facing the Smith bar with knees soft and take a wide overhand grip.
Release the hooks and hinge at your hips until the bar hangs beneath your shoulders and your back stays steady.
Pull the bar straight upward toward your upper chest while flaring your elbows out wide to target your rear delts and upper back.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension without losing your hinged back posture.
tips: Lead with wide elbows rather than tucking them close to your ribs like a standard lat row.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears as you squeeze your upper back.
